name: Effect
tagline: A TypeScript library for composing applications with typed effects, concurrency, and resource management.
hook: Validation distinguishes type tests, JSDoc text, and runnable examples; generated-file rules apply only to marked sections.
summary: Effect keeps its contributor instructions in .agents/AGENTS.md. The guide maps change types to focused validation and describes which source files own generated outputs. It also draws two boundaries that prevent overbroad work: avoid watch-mode full suites, and preserve hand-maintained index files and unmarked sections.

techniques.title: Distinguish type checks, prose, and executable examples
techniques.body: The validation table gives API type changes, JSDoc text changes, and JSDoc examples different commands. Documentation-only work does not need tests unless examples or code changed.
techniques.quote:
Use the narrowest validation that covers the change:

| Change type                      | Validation                                                                         |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Code changes                     | `pnpm lint-fix`, targeted `pnpm test --run <test_file.ts>`, `pnpm check`           |
| Tests-only changes               | `pnpm lint-fix`, targeted `pnpm test --run <test_file.ts>`, `pnpm check`           |
| Type-level/API type changes      | Targeted `pnpm test-types <filename>`, plus `pnpm check` when source types changed |
| JSDoc text/category/link changes | `pnpm jsdocs --check`, `pnpm lint`                                                 |
| JSDoc example changes            | `pnpm jsdocs --check`, `pnpm lint`, root `pnpm doctest --run <files>`              |
| Docs-only changes                | `pnpm lint-fix`; no tests unless examples or code changed                          |

techniques.title: Prevent accidental watch-mode suites
techniques.body: The guide explains why bare test commands are prohibited: they start the whole suite in watch mode. It requires explicit run mode and file selection, leaving the full suite to CI.
techniques.quote:
Never run bare `pnpm test` or `pnpm doctest`; both start the full suite in watch mode. Always pass `--run` and the
specific files covering the change. CI runs the full suite.

techniques.title: Guard generated regions without freezing the whole file
techniques.body: The barrel rule applies to marked sections, with an explicit exception for hand-maintained index files and unmarked sections. The following paragraph names the source directories for generated AI documentation and migration notes.
techniques.quote:
Some `index.ts` sections marked with `@barrel` are generated. Do not edit those
sections manually; update their source modules and run `pnpm codegen`.
Hand-maintained `index.ts` files and unmarked sections are not covered by this
rule.

steal: Give type-level changes and executable documentation their own validation paths.
Name commands that unexpectedly start full suites or watch mode, and provide bounded alternatives.
Define generated regions precisely, including what remains hand-maintained.
Point each generated artifact at the source and command used to rebuild it.
